title: Does not get cold enough.
text: Does not get cold enough.. I bought this to keep juice boxes cold for my grand baby. It will not cool down a juice box from room temperature.  It was returned.

product_metadata.title: Frigidaire EFMIS129-MINT 6 Can Beverage Cooler, Mint, 4 Liters
features: THE MOST CONVENIENT MICRO-FRIDGE: This compact fridge is perfect for everyday use. You can use it to store your lunch, drinks and baby bottles.
PORTABLE MINI COOLER: 3 pounds, perfect for on the go. You can place this fridge in your office or dorm. Multiple types of chargers in box.
GREAT FOR SMALL SPACES: This mini-fridge is (10 x 7 x 10 inches) has a flush-back design that allows for multiple placement options in any room

COMPACT: 4 Liter capacity chills six 12 oz. soda cans; interior is 5 x 5 x 7. 5 and includes a removable shelf that offers a variety of storage options so you can store small items such as yoghurt, fruit, milk, bottles etc
GO GREEN : This product was engineered with thermoelectric technology. It uses advanced semiconductors that are free of CFCs and refrigerants, making it better for the environment.
description: MINI COOLER, MAXIMUM CHILL. The Frigidaire Portable Personal Fridge keeps your food and drinks the perfect temperature while at home and on the go. The ultimate versatile cooler, this mini fridge goes from cooling to heating with just the flip of a switch. Cools up to 32°F below ambient temperature, and warms up to 140°F at an ambient temperature of 75°F. Compact space saving design and lightweight features make it easy to take with you anywhere, yet can still fit your needs; 4 Liter capacity chills six 12 oz. cans, while a removable shelf makes it easy to store milk, juice, yogurt, bottles, smoothies, cheese, fruit, coffee, soup, and many more home cooked meals or beverages. Perfect for personal spaces, bedrooms, offices, hotels, boats, carpools, soccer games, sporting events, backyard BBQ, pool parties and more! Conveniently plugs into standard home outlets and other chargers so you can take with you anywhere you go. 100% Freon-Free and advanced safety technology for long-lasting durability.
